factor.description: Fitted over record burn coefficient; with another exponent than the record it also holds the change of the meaning of the coefficient.

rows.description: Used training rows of the powder.

chiSquarePerDegree.description: Chi square of every row, data and the prior rows of the rifle and lot effects, over all rows minus all parameters; null where that count is not above 0.

pressureExponent.description: With `--exponent family`: the exponent of its family, the value fitted at it.

pressureRows.description: With `--pressure-sigma`: used training rows whose printed pressure the fit read, those of a basis with a factor.

value.description: Specific energy laid over the record, J/kg: the prior impetus times the energy-level factor of `energy.factor`, over the record's `interior.gamma` minus 1.

prior.description: Where the prior impetus came from: `own`, the powder's thermochemistry; `base`, the median of the own impetus values of its propellant base; `pooled`, the median of all own impetus values.

powders.description: By powder id: each powder fitted on its own.

notFitted.description: By powder id, why a powder with interior parameters that the rows name got no value: the reason of the fit (with `--exponent family`, of the fit at the exponent of its family), or `noUsableRow` without a used training row.

energy.description: With `--energy prior`: each powder's energy is its prior impetus times one energy-level factor shared by all powders, over its `interior.gamma` minus 1, chosen on the training pressures; per powder only the burn coefficient is fitted.

factor.description: The chosen energy-level factor, the grid value with the least objective.

grid.description: The energy-level factors tried, one fit each.

objective.description: Per grid value, the median of |ln(model peak / printed pressure)| over the same rows at every value that takes part: the training rows that print a pressure in bar and have a model peak at every such value, so only rows of powders fitted at all of them. A value takes part when at least 90 % of the powders fitted at any value are fitted at it; null where it does not.

pressureRows.description: Rows of the objective, the same at every factor that takes part.

priors.description: How many powders took each kind of prior, of the powders the rows name that have interior parameters, fitted or not.
